propositions: git commit --amend -F FILE replaces the entire commit message and drops the Change-Id trailer, causing Gerrit to stamp a new Change-Id and create a duplicate change instead of a new patchset
prepare-commit-msg hook cannot detect an amend invocation with -F (git reports identical source and empty sha as a fresh -F commit), so hook-based prevention is unfeasible

A make amend-msg wrapper that preserves the Change-Id trailer from HEAD while rewriting the message with FILE contents is the documented solution, following practice in Go, OpenStack, Android, and Chromium projects
make amend-msg must fail loudly and non-zero if HEAD carries no Change-Id, rather than silently producing a commit that will be re-stamped
AGENTS.md documentation must name make amend-msg as the path for rewritten commit messages and explicitly warn that --amend -m / -F drop Change-Id and create duplicate Gerrit changes
